name: of_results_think
statement: Computation α} {a n} (h : Results (think s) a n) : ∃ m, Results s a m ∧ n = m + 1

name: results_thinkN
statement: Computation α} {a m} : ∀ n, Results s a m → Results (thinkN s n) a (m + n) | 0, h => h | n + 1, h => results_think (results_thinkN n h)  theorem results_thinkN_pure (a : α) (n) : Results (thinkN (pure a) n) a n

have_tree.body: results_thinkN n (results_pure a); rwa [Nat.zero_add] at this

name: results_bind
